_about: What each AI provider charges per million tokens, in US dollars, before any discount. Ledgy will not call a model that is not listed here, so no AI answer is ever sold unmetered. Check against the providers' pricing pages and update this file (or point LEDGERLINE_AI_PRICES at your own copy) whenever they change. Long-prompt surcharges do not apply: Ledgy's prompts are a few thousand tokens.
